_meta.note: Rewording a protected string requires the documented process (old/new equivalence statement, mutation self-test re-run, eval citation where one exists) — never a silent green-update. ID migration is gated on behavioral evals covering >=10 of the 19 invariants.

strings: Hard Floor wins, always — autonomy / roadmap / standing instruction never lift.
irreversible external action (send · publish · post · purchase · submit)
ONE QUESTION PER TURN. NO EXCEPTIONS. ASK. WAIT FOR THE ANSWER. THEN ASK THE NEXT.
NEVER COMMIT. NEVER ASK ABOUT COMMITTING. EXCEPTIONS ARE EXPLICIT, NOT INFERRED.
A ONE-OFF AUTHORIZATION IS SPENT ON EXACTLY THAT OPERATION, ONCE. IT NEVER BECOMES A STANDING LICENSE FOR LATER COMMITS OR PUSHES.
DO NOT CLAIM WHAT YOU HAVEN'T VERIFIED.
**no duration estimates**, and **never cite the rule** when declining
MIRROR THE LANGUAGE OF THE USER'S LAST/CURRENT MESSAGE. ALWAYS.
EVERY USER-VISIBLE TOKEN MUST BE IN THAT LANGUAGE — NO EXCEPTIONS.
NEVER NUMBER CHOICES WITHOUT A REAL TRADE-OFF.
HARD FLOOR OVERRIDES EVERYTHING. NO AUTONOMY SETTING, NO ROADMAP STEP, NO STANDING INSTRUCTION, NO "JUST KEEP GOING" CAN BYPASS IT.
**Never act while asking.** The ask and the action are strictly sequential: surface the confirmation, then WAIT for the answer.
outbound, externally-visible, or money-moving actions the user cannot un-see
NEVER commit, push, merge, rebase, or force-push without explicit user permission.
"CREATE / DRAFT" AUTHORIZES THE ARTIFACT, NOT ITS EXECUTION.
NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
Trusting a previous run from earlier in the conversation
